body_markdown:
ROCHESTER, NY, May 18, 2026 – Transcat, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRNS) (“Transcat” or the “Company”), a leading provider of test measurement, control and calibration services, announced that it will release its results for the fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 ended March 28, 2026 after the close of financial markets on Tuesday, May 26, 2026.


Transcat President and Chief Executive Officer Jaime Irick and Chief Financial Officer Thomas Barbato will host a conference call and webcast on Tuesday, May 26, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. ET to review the financial and operating results


[Listen to Webcast](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1758089&tp_key=b56742249d)


[Read the Full Press Release](https://www.transcat.com/media/pdf/TRNS-Q4-2026-Earnings-Call-Announcement-FINAL-5-18-26.pdf)
